pick.name: Context7 (Upstash)
pick.why: Largest library index; official marketplace plugin
pick.free_limits: 1,000 API calls/month + 20 bonus/day after; Pro $10/seat/mo with 2,000 calls

best_free.name: DeepWiki MCP (Cognition)
best_free.what: Ask questions about any public GitHub repo
best_free.why: Free, no auth; great for understanding an OSS dependency
best_free.free_limits: Free, no auth, public repositories only; private repos need a Devin account and the Devin MCP
best_free.install: claude mcp add -s user -t http deepwiki https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp

alts.name: GitMCP
alts.what: Remote MCP that turns any GitHub repo or Pages site into a docs source
alts.why: Zero setup, no key, repo-specific docs
alts.free_limits: free service, no cost per its FAQ
alts.install: claude mcp add --transport http gitmcp https://gitmcp.io/docs

candidates.name: WebFetch + llms.txt
candidates.verdict: fallback once Context7 quota is hit

decision: Context7's 1,000 calls a month covers a solo dev and stops API hallucinations on fast-moving libraries. When the quota runs out, fall back to WebFetch on llms.txt rather than paying.

verify.note: Verified: 1,000 calls/month free then 20 bonus/day; Pro $10/seat with 2,000 calls/seat, $5 per extra 1k.
